exposure: Maternal antibiotic use in the second or third trimester of pregnancy
cohort: 436 mother-child pairs from the Northern Manhattan Mothers and Children Study, followed until the children were 7 years old
finding: Both cesarean section delivery and maternal antibiotic use in the second or third trimester were independently associated with a higher risk of childhood obesity at age 7.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a 46% higher risk of childhood obesity, regardless of whether it was elective or non-elective.
birth_weight: Mentioned as a confounder, but specific range not provided
